## Outcome

Describe the user-visible, statistical, or control-plane result.

## Controlled surfaces

- [ ] Product claim / intended-use boundary reviewed
- [ ] Clinical programs, specifications, metadata, or datasets changed
- [ ] TFL, reviewer, Module 5, or eCTD artifacts changed
- [ ] Pipeline, CI, dependency, provenance, or release controls changed
- [ ] No patient data, credential, or confidential material is included

## Evidence and validation

List exact commands, environments, and results. State explicitly whether the
genuine SAS/ODA full DAG, data-bearing R checks, licensed validators, clean
checkout, release verifier, and browser/visual QA were executed or unavailable.

## Findings and residual risk

Link any findings-register rows or decision records. Explain accepted limits,
external owner decisions, and evidence that must be refreshed before promotion.

## Release effect

- [ ] No release-seal effect
- [ ] Governance/reviewer-only change eligible for the documented narrow policy
- [ ] Fresh genuine full-DAG run and release reseal required

This checklist records engineering review; it is not a sponsor approval,
electronic signature, Part 11 record, or regulatory-submission authorization.
